title: Jobless Era
description: Drop in any employer and get a brutally specific, instantly shareable 3-slide roast of exactly why working there destroys human souls — then watch it climb the trending feed.

title: Draft Phantom
description: Your half-finished drafts haunt a graveyard ranked by decay score — write a few sentences and watch it drop live, then exorcise the draft when it's ready.

title: Exit Strategy
description: A one-click FIRE calculator that chains your salary, local job market data, and index-fund growth into the exact month you can resign — and flags in red the moment your spending drifts.

title: Reverse Auction
description: Post a task and a budget, then watch specialists bid the price down in real time until you accept the lowest offer.

title: Debt Arena
description: Auction off your debts and obligations to other players in real time — highest bidder takes your burden for cash and burden credits.

title: Bet Archive
description: Log predictions with stakes and odds, resolve them as they come true or don't, and watch your lifetime Brier score and calibration curve update.

title: Streak Breaker
description: Log three daily habits to fill the coin meter, then unlock a playable neon brick-breaker arcade game at 3/3.

title: Depth Betting
description: Wager real stakes for or against your friends' goals — win double if you bet on their success, keep your stake if you bet against it.

title: Habit Arcade
description: Gamify tiny daily habits — log one, watch XP and streaks climb, unlock a retro reflex mini-game when you clear all three for the day.

title: Doppelgänger
description: An AI that drafts texts in your voice while you're busy — you approve every reply before it sends, nothing goes out on its own.

title: Persona Drafts
description: One tap makes a full TTRPG or story character — name, class, quirks, and a backstory — pick a genre and keep the ones you like.

title: Star Rally
description: A Mario Party-inspired board game for your phone — roll, race around the board, and win stars in 5 quick mini-games. Single-device demo, up to 6 players.

title: Editorial OS
description: A mobile-first editorial intelligence dashboard — tracks how your thinking evolves over time, from a single observation to a strengthening thesis to a published piece.
